description: Bounded rational denominator probe comparison and selected six-step implementation.
decision: Select six remainders: smallest tested bound completing the 13N/21N fixture; eight adds unnecessary coprime probe work for this case.
method: Full 48-case runs per variant and Node major; six alternating paired runs for four versus eight and four versus six, restricted to 20000-digit delayed-shared/Fibonacci explanations. Each workload uses five retained calls and two untimed exact-value controls. No timed trials overlap builds or tests.
reproduction: Run scripts/exact-sum-bench.mjs on isolated copies of packages/solver/src with only the fraction-sum probe step bound set to 4, 6 or 8. Focused paired runs restrict digits to 20000, family to delayed-shared/fibonacci and operation to explain; alternate baseline/candidate order for six pairs.
